caption: The drawing shows a single wooden table with a square top and a central, turned pedestal leg. The tabletop is medium brown with a visible wood grain pattern and slightly beveled edges. Underneath the tabletop are triangular corner supports connecting to a single, ornately shaped and rounded pedestal that narrows in the middle and widens towards both ends with carved rings and curves. The pedestal ends at a rectangular block that connects to a simple cross-shaped base made of four short, thick rectangular feet extending at right angles. The table is depicted against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Candle Stand
